learnerLabel: Revised QA Control Review by Stephania Malagon

sections.title: Business need
sections.value: QA Cell traceability and command ownership needs to improve, both are unclear.

sections.title: Expected value and beneficiaries
sections.value: The QA and Engineering team, including Nia Voss, can benefit from clarity and transparency that comes with improving QA Cell traceability and command ownership. The QA team lost a lot of time trying to find out who owned what command.

sections.title: Excluded work
sections.value: This review does not authorize any expenses, nor deletion of any records or robots.

sections.title: Technical feasibility
sections.value: Yes, as stated in W02-S04, the QA team members were able to locate the command custodian and original source. The access condition is that if access is denied, the team must revise the work or defer it.

sections.title: Operational feasibility
sections.value: Yes, the Operations team needs to confirm availability.

sections.title: Cost and resource feasibility
sections.value: According to W02-S05, the 8-day plan has two business days of headroom against the 10-day limit so overtime pay is excluded. That amount also excludes equipment and licenses.

sections.title: Schedule feasibility
sections.value: The 8-day plan heavily relies on whether that plan continues without setbacks.

sections.title: Known constraints
sections.value: As Elias stated, late exports and QA shift reassignment can change the 8-day plan.

sections.title: Risks and assumptions
sections.value: Hours for each team can change the estimate or delivery, their schedules need to be checked for availability and Mara Ilyan can check that.

sections.title: Success measures and evidence
sections.value: The sponsor can check the later value by comparing the current cost estimate to what it actually ends up being. As well as the current staff minutes compared to what it might be in the future.

sections.title: Rationale and conditions
sections.value: I chose to revise because the plan needs adjustment for some unknowns such as the team schedules(W02-S01), cost estimates(W02-S05). The most compelling evidence is how the QA team knew what to do and how to do it, they did not lack resources to accomplish their tasks, they only needed command authorization and access.

sections.title: Next authorization or information step
sections.value: The team leaders can decide what they need and what their teams need to do.
